restaurant_name: PHD Clinic Phuket (Hair Transplant and Aesthetics)
text: I have had a problem with baldness in the front for many years. So I came to have a hair transplant with PHD and chose to be a review case for the clinic to receive a special price that the admin offered me. The doctors who transplanted for me were a team of the doctors from the American board and have more than 16 years of experience. They also guarantee the hair transplant for 1 year. If it doesn't grow, they are happy to transplant it for me again for free, which made me decided to transplant here. All the team of doctors here are experts and nice. They didn't make me afraid before the surgery. During the surgery, I felt relaxed. After the hair transplant, I got excellent results from this transplant, which I am very satisfied with. I plan to take my friends to have a beard transplant at PHD soon. 👍

restaurant_name: PHD Clinic Phuket (Hair Transplant and Aesthetics)
text:
My Personal experience!

All smiles in the beginning as it usually is. Terrible service and rushed treatment from nurses fronted as International and American board hair doctors.

Having hair issues is stressful enough. I was misdiagnosed and after having my blood taken and a bunch of prp needling x3 which is also not fun, I actually seen Dr Teerasak Pattayadeekul in the clinic. Dr Teerasak told me this diagnosis was incorrect and should be changed as it’s not sufficient to fix my problem.
Also, my money should be refunded and added towards “the correct treatment” and I should pay more mony for deposit to confirm surgery at a later date, which I did.

They tried to hurry for a surgery 2-3 days later telling me the doctors have already booked flights, however there was no surgery confirmation on my side which was a bit alarming.

We agreed to a date they cancelled and my money has not been refunded for the misdiagnosis or further payment I made.
